brief.promise: Upload a voice recording and get a searchable transcript back.
brief.primaryUser: One person recording meeting and idea notes on a laptop
brief.problem: Recordings pile up unheard because nothing turns them into text that can be searched.
brief.currentAlternative: Re-listening to recordings to find one sentence
brief.usage: A few recordings a day, each a few minutes long
brief.visualDirection: Plain single page, system font: an upload control, a recordings list with status, a search box, and a transcript view
brief.deployment: Local Node server listening on the PORT it is given
coreWorkflow: Upload a WAV file from the browser
Watch its status go from pending to transcribed (or failed)
Export a transcript as a .txt file or delete the recording
mustHaves: Upload a WAV file (PCM, up to 50 MB); the server stores it under data/recordings/ and records its duration in seconds read from the WAV header
A non-WAV or truncated file is rejected with a clear message and nothing is stored

Transcription runs the command named in the TRANSCRIBE_CMD environment variable with the audio path as its last argument (TRANSCRIBE_CMD may include arguments separated by spaces, such as node scripts/fake-transcribe.js) and takes its stdout as the transcript; it runs in the background, one recording at a time, so uploads return immediately
Each recording shows status pending, transcribing, transcribed or failed; a failed recording shows the command's error and can be retried
Recordings still pending or transcribing when the server stops are transcribed after it restarts
Search returns recordings whose transcript contains every search word, case-insensitive
Export downloads the transcript as <recording name>.txt
Delete removes the recording, its audio file and its transcript
Metadata and transcripts persist in data/recordings.json across restarts
dataAndAccess: Audio in data/recordings/, metadata in data/recordings.json
integrations: A local transcription command (for example whisper.cpp) named by TRANSCRIBE_CMD; tests use a fake command script
acceptanceScenarios: Uploading a 3-second 16 kHz mono WAV shows it in the list with duration 3 s and status pending, then transcribed with the fake command's output
Uploading a text file renamed to .wav is rejected with a clear message and the list is unchanged
When TRANSCRIBE_CMD exits with an error the recording shows failed with that error; after fixing the command, Retry transcribes it
With transcripts 'budget meeting notes' and 'meeting with Sam', searching 'Meeting budget' returns only the first
A recording left pending when the server stops is transcribed after a restart
Deleting a recording removes it from the list and its file from data/recordings/
constraints: Node 24 or newer, no runtime npm dependencies; tests use node:test
npm test runs only fast tests under test/
manualChecks: Transcribe a real recording with whisper.cpp set as TRANSCRIBE_CMD

transcript.content: A local voice-notes app: I upload WAV recordings, it stores them, transcribes them with a local command, and lets me search, read, export and delete transcripts.
